title: Qt: Check if focusWidget() is nullptr when setting previous focus
description:
mainApp->focusWidget() can return nullptr. If it does, don't try
to connect the nullptr's destroyed() signal to anything. This
prevents some console warnings:

 ** (wireshark:944001) 18:03:36.929460 [GUI WARNING] -- QObject::connect: Cannot connect (nullptr)::destroyed() to WiresharkMainWindow::resetPreviousFocus()

Fix #18345


(cherry picked from commit 8aaef0e515e3bdaa23169a24aaa798a7f16e0924)
